result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a major graphical artifact on a food image and a minor layout positioning defect with the notification badge.

issues.description: The image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' contains a prominent dark green rectangular shape that appears to be an image artifact or graphical glitch.
issues.suggestion: Replace or properly mask the image to remove the unnatural floating rectangle.

issues.description: In the top right corner, the red notification badge is positioned noticeably too high on its circular background, making it look detached from the bell icon itself.
issues.suggestion: Position the badge closer to the top-right vertex of the bell icon.
